tools.title: GitGuardian

servers.name: GitGuardian MCP Server (hosted)
servers.capabilities: List, triage, assign and resolve secret incidents, revoke secrets, create honeytokens and scan code for leaked credentials.

servers.name: GitGuardian MCP Server (local stdio)
servers.capabilities: Same tools run locally; browser login by default, or a personal access token with ENABLE_LOCAL_OAUTH=false for headless use.

tools.notes: EU workspaces use https://mcp.eu1.gitguardian.com/mcp. The local server is installed from the Git repository with uvx, not from a package registry.

tools.title: Semgrep
tools.summary: Static analysis (SAST), supply chain and secrets scanning.

servers.name: Semgrep MCP Server (semgrep mcp)
servers.capabilities: Scan code with Semgrep Code, Supply Chain and Secrets from the agent; stdio by default, streamable HTTP with -t streamable-http.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: The standalone semgrep/mcp repository (uvx semgrep-mcp, mcp.semgrep.ai/sse) is archived and deprecated; the server now ships in the semgrep binary. SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN is only needed to connect to the Semgrep AppSec Platform.

tools.title: Snyk
tools.summary: Developer security platform: code, open source, container and IaC scanning.

servers.name: Snyk MCP Server (Snyk CLI)
servers.capabilities: Run Snyk Code, Open Source and IaC scans from the agent through the local Snyk CLI; optional SNYK_MCP_PROFILE selects the tool profile (lite, full, experimental).
servers.access: Runs locally through the Snyk CLI with access to local files: dependency, code, container, infrastructure-as-code, SBOM and secrets scans; snyk_trust trusts a repository directory. What is sent to Snyk is not on the page.
servers.scopes: snyk auth signs in through the browser; the scans run in the configured Snyk organization.

tools.notes: Requires Snyk CLI 1.1307.4 or later and a prior `snyk auth` browser login; the docs use the absolute path to the snyk binary as command. Snyk states there is no hosted remote scanning MCP server.

tools.title: Socket
tools.summary: Supply chain security for open source dependencies.

servers.name: Socket MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Get security scores and metadata for packages across npm, PyPI, cargo, Maven, NuGet, Go and more, and audit dependency lists.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: The README says the project is in early development. It can also run locally from the npm package @socketsecurity/mcp.

tools.title: Trivy
tools.summary: Open source scanner for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in images, filesystems and repositories.

servers.name: Trivy MCP Server Plugin
servers.capabilities: Scan filesystems, container images and remote repositories for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in natural language; optional Aqua Platform integration.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: Install first with `trivy plugin install mcp`. Last release v0.0.20 (December 2025), so activity is low. Aqua Platform credentials are optional.
